title: gui: Health v2 panel (complexity, hotspots, god files, cycles) + graph tinting
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W4]
Seats: DSN-03, DSN-04
crates/gui/src/health/mod.rs + sidebar section: sortable lists for most-complex functions, hotspots, god files (fan-out/LOC), cycles, unused-variable count; each row clickable (function -> CFG tab, file -> text, cycle -> graph). Graph tinting option: color nodes by complexity (diverging token ramp) or cycle membership, off by default. Uses core::complexity + existing metrics. Owner: crates/gui/src/health/*, sidebar wiring. Verify: cargo build/clippy/test -p repowalk-gui; values shown equal core::complexity output on fixtures.
EVIDENCE:
File: crates/gui/src/health/mod.rs only (DSN-3 batch B3, seat DSN-02). No app.rs/sidebar/ui_kit/theme/core edit. The sidebar Health tab already calls health::ui, so no wiring change was needed.

What the panel shows (sidebar -> Health):
- Overview strip from metrics::compute: files · LOC · symbols · cycles (cycles tinted SUCCESS at 0 else WARNING).
- Complexity by module (metrics::complexity_by_module, core-sorted by total desc): one row per crate/dir/module with `Σtotal · max · N fn`; click opens the module's entry file (lib.rs/main.rs/mod.rs/index.*, else first) in Text mode; selection follows the open file.
- God files (metrics::god_files): the flagging rule is always spelled out, never a bare number — e.g. `loc · 1617 L · fan-out 133`, `fan-out · 1299 L · fan-out 172`; click opens the file.
- Hotspots (metrics::hotspots, top 12 of the ranked bundle): `cyc N · nest M` with the function's file:line; click jumps to the line in Text mode; cyc>=20 tinted WARNING.
- Unused variables (metrics::unused_variable_count) + Guardrails: every rules::check Finding is tinted by severity (Severity::Error -> theme::DANGER, Warning -> theme::WARNING) and labelled with severity tag + rule name + file:line; click opens the finding. Findings are rendered in the pre-sorted core order (no re-sort). A clean run prints `no findings — every rule passes` (SUCCESS) instead of nothing; an all-empty Rules::default prints `no guardrails configured...` instead (distinct states).
- Honest states: no index -> centered notice; index present but Analysis missing -> overview + index-only guardrails (with `the cyclomatic rule needs the v2 analysis`) and an explicit unavailable list for Complexity by module / God files / Hotspots / Unused variables, each naming the v2 analysis it needs — never a 0 shown as a result.

Caching (no app.rs edit possible): bundles (v1 Metrics, v2 MetricsV2, module->file index, findings) are cached in egui temp memory under a signature key mirroring App::graph_state's `((edges,symbols,…),built)` pattern — fingerprint = (index Arc ptr, file/symbol/edge/import counts, analysis Arc ptr, cfg/variable/type/module counts). A matching key reuses cached Arcs, so the whole bundle is computed once per artifact, not once per frame. Degradation: rules.json is read with the artifact (config edits apply on next learn/re-open, no per-frame I/O).

Real numbers on this repo (single learn, consistent snapshot): files=344, LOC=51908, symbols=1836, cycles=1; complexity_by_module rows=83 (top: core Crate total=1817 max=41 fns=649 files=36; crates/gui/src Module total=1280 max=30 fns=487 files=33); god_files=6 (Cargo.lock loc 4860; analyze/python.rs loc 1617 fan_out 133; analyze/rust.rs loc 1585 fan_out 142; gui/notes.rs fan-out 172; graph/render.rs fan-out 188; app.rs fan-out 158); hotspots=1449 (top: analyze/python.rs:605 cyc 41 nest 3; core/tour.rs:17 cyc 37 nest 4); unused_variables=525; rules.json = forbid core->gui + gui->cli, max_cyclomatic 50, max_file_loc 5000, no_cycles crates/**; findings=0 -> panel renders the clean-run line.
